hypothesis: Per-canonicalization immutable alias-subtree memoization plus DAG-aware node-pair equality can remove repeated alias-DAG materialization without changing current nominal alias or cycle semantics.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Memoization may leak across active alias-cycle paths or sibling branches, or merely move the resource explosion into another consumer such as diagnostic rendering.

production_delta.canonicalization: Per-call completed-alias subtree cache; active DFS alias path retained; cycle-observing subtrees are not cached.
production_delta.equality: Visited canonical node-pair identities prevent repeated comparison of shared DAG pairs.

unusual_experiment.name: SHARED_DAG_DIAGNOSTIC_RENDER_EXPANSION
unusual_experiment.interpretation: Structural sharing bounds canonical TypeRef object materialization but the existing diagnostic renderer can still unfold a shared DAG exponentially into text. No new diagnostic syntax or truncation contract was selected in this GO.

next_falsifier: Require exact-head self-hosted PASS for the direct production DAG integration workflow, then separately define and test a bounded diagnostic-render contract without changing Clay type semantics.
